newsitem.title: USA: Kmart Corp Q3 Oct 30 profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Kmart Corp Q3 Oct 30 profit vs loss.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1995 Q3 includes gain of $49 million, or $0.11 a share, from disposal of discontinued operations. 1995 Q3 ended October 25, 1995.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1996 nine-month period includes charge of $61 million, or $0.13 a share, from discontinued operations, including the revaluation of the company's remaining holdings in Thrifty Payless Holdings Inc.
The 1995 nine-month period included a gain of $83 million, or $0.18 a share, from pension curtailments, and the loss of $30 million, or $0.06 a share, from divestiture of discontinued operations.
Kmart's same-store sales rose 0.1 percent during the third quarter compared with a year earlier, while same-store sales for the nine month period rose 1.8 percent.
